children: Gravity (by Galxe) ends native bridge support for transfers of G out of Gravity Alpha Mainnet at 8:00 PM PDT on October 25, 2026, as part of its transition to Gravity L1 Mainnet.
The native bridge connects Gravity Alpha Mainnet to Ethereum. The cutoff sets a deadline for G holders using that route to move tokens out of Alpha Mainnet ahead of the full L1 Mainnet launch.
As part of the transition to Gravity L1 Mainnet, Fast Withdraw from Gravity Alpha Mainnet to Ethereum will be paused on October 23, 2026, at 8:00 PM PDT.
